system.description:
You infuse chakra into a chakra seal as you attempt to end a jutsu with the seal of Dispis.

Choose any creature, object, or chakra-based effect you can see as you mark it with your chakra seal. You then Dispel any Ninjutsu or Genjutsu currently affecting it of a rank less than the rank this jutsu was cast at.

If the target has ranks of Sealed, Sealed you can remove up to two ranks with this jutsu’s casting.

If the Jutsu is of a rank equal to this jutsu, you must make a Ninshou skill check vs the DC of the jutsu effect you are targeting.

If the jutsu is of a rank higher than this jutsu, you make the check at disadvantage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3.
